value.text: Triggering an Elemental Reaction increases the equipping character's Elemental Mastery by <color=#36ffff>60/75/90/105/120</color> for 12s, while triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction increases their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by <color=#36ffff>16%/20%/24%/28%/32%</color> for 12s. desc.text:
Domovoy born with statures considered small even amongst their people struggle to find a place to belong, no matter where they go.
The beasts would mock their hunched forms, and humans were wary of their strange appearances.
Must they be forced to bear the sin of betrayal from birth on account of their kin who had pledged loyalty to humans?
Was there no other way to carve out a place for oneself beyond becoming a jester to be made sport of, thus ingratiating oneself with the powerful?
"Know this, my lost kin: the realm that the Tsaritsa has created has no place in it for us."
"Seek vengeance against humanity, for their sowing of discord and their preposterous plays at power. We fae were the original masters of ice and snow."
The hunchbacked Domovoy was thus accepted by the Burner of Cities and her servants, and he served beneath the banner of old royalty.
Alongside the brutal wolf-fae, he listened to the sublime edicts of the wise one, and from then on followed the banner of destruction and emptiness.
This spy by the Burner of Cities' side was one day discovered, and they subjected him to alternating rounds of torture and persuasion.
"You ingrate! We accepted an outsider such as you, only to be rewarded with treachery."
"Yet a lost lamb may still be forgiven and granted blessed protection, so long as they speak truth from now."
Yet for all the rattling of the chains or all the honey poured on, silence was the answer the executioners received.
Humiliated and infuriated, the brigands moved to execute the Domovoy cruelly, all the better to warn others of a traitor's fate.
Faced with the axe and eternal slumber, the figure that once stooped now unveiled his commanding height.
"Ideals that conceal selfishness and hatred should not be allowed to deceive the world. The scheme to destroy the Torches must be stopped for justice to be done."
"The Domovoy serve not humanity, but the future of all life. Away with all this ostentation! Death shall taste sweet to me."
Through echoes in the relics he left behind, he was able to bring a secret report to his companions, along with the bright future he would not live to see.
This then was the tale of the Domovoy, a fleeting existence in transient time, whose steadfastness earned not a single chronicler's plaudit.
Only the guiding one resolved to settle his grudge, for the sake of their friendship, for his long years of persistence,
For the oath of loyalty he had made and not forgotten, for he had never once lost his way amidst the long, cold nights.
"To bow and scrape is not my way. One day, the world shall know,"
"That even at the last, Varenukha did not bend."

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Rise of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
In the east of the tundra, that arrogant monster born within the wing-like mountain is nothing more than a lowly peddler of malt and minerals.
The Vila under his command are but weaklings with insect wings, while the Domovoy cannot even lift weapons with their stunted arms.
Who would heed the clamor of such rabble? What strength could they possibly have to stand against the onslaught of the kings of Volkodlak?

materials.name: Accreted Fragment
materials.desc:
An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.
An accretion that has only just begun to attach to an internal organ or bone. As the Volkodlak's power grows, it may eventually cover an entire region of the body, or a whole organ.

materials.name: Ethereal Glimmershard
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
These shards once coated the creature's body like crystalline scales. Upon falling away, they stripped themselves of all colors, shifting into something akin to the dusty dross of a moth's wings.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Muster of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"They seized the canyon by sheer luck. That laughably arrogant fool is no more than a spent bolt, a fading gale."
"Even with all their strength, they can barely hold back a fraction of our forces. Soon enough, their defeat will be plain to see."
"Soldiers, march onward! For our king has already foretold, for this entire campaign shall end in effortless victory!"

materials.name: Accreted Mass
materials.desc:
An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.
An accretion that has clung to an internal organ or bone for a long time. Once removed, such accretions are regarded as symbols of power and carefully preserved by the creature's descendants.

materials.name: Ethereal Crystal
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A shattered fragment of the crystalline scales that once grew upon the fae's body. Though it is now a mere empty shell, one can still sense the echo of the unique power that once dwelt within.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Clarion of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"Our enemy Monomakh has built his palace beyond the valley, a sign that he is fully confident in his ability to contend with us."
"As matters stand, he deserves our utmost caution. Any talk of a swift victory should now be set aside."
"But it matters not. With wisdom to guide us all, the King shall stand with the clans to overcome every hardship and usher in a glorious new era!"

materials.name: Accreted Growth
materials.desc:
An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.
An accretion that has fully fused with an organ or bone. One could even say it's a newly grown bone or organ at the nodes of the Volkodlak's power circulation. Only long-lived Volkodlaks who have ceaselessly honed their strength can form such growths within their bodies.

materials.name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.

materials.name: Triumph of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"All hail the Tsar, Protector of all fae, Heir to the Pale Star, sovereign born of sacred blood!"
"Praise be, for the entire tundra now stands as one beneath the brilliance of the Polestar!"
"Praise be, for His Majesty has slain the false king and embraced all fae. Such is his benevolence, such is his mercy!"

customize.name: Borderland Catalyst Billet
customize.desc:
Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star catalysts.

In terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...

customize.name: Rainbowdrop Crystal
customize.desc:
A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.
It is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

customize.name: White Iron Chunk
customize.desc: Skilled hands can make this into something brilliant.

customize.name: Diagram: Echoes of the Heart
customize.desc: A blueprint recreated by Kuzmichev based on records of old legends. Learn it and you can restore Echoes of the Heart (Catalyst).

customize.name: Emberwell
customize.desc: A longsword that is entirely gemstone, said to be crafted for the path of righteousness. When unsheathed, it glows with the luster of blue flame.

customize.name: Blade of Atonement
customize.desc: A greatsword passed down by the Luchkin. It is said that only the bravest warrior is qualified to wield it.

customize.name: Song of the Vigil
customize.desc: A long spear that once stood guard over all. Today, it has found a new purpose with children and their games of make-believe.

customize.name: Covenant of Frost and Snow
customize.desc: A longbow crafted to preserve order. Its cold radiance perfectly emanates the ideals of absolute fairness and justice.
